trello.name: Fix staging deployment by rotating expired registry token in CI
trello.desc: The staging environment is broken because the CI deploy job cannot pull the base image. The root cause is an expired registry token that was not updated when tokens were rotated yesterday. Steps: (1) Regenerate a new registry token. (2) Update the CI secret with the new registry token. (3) Re-run the staging deploy job. (4) Verify the deploy job goes green and staging is functional. (5) Confirm to Kim that staging is back online. Acceptance criteria: Staging deploy job is green, base image pulls successfully, and team members can test in staging again. Follow-up: Review token rotation process to ensure CI secrets are included in future rotations.

trello.name: Send updated Meridian proposal with new pricing to Lena by end of day
trello.desc: Meridian has requested an updated proposal reflecting the new pricing. Kim has promised delivery by end of day today. Steps: (1) Locate the spreadsheet containing the final pricing numbers. (2) Open the existing proposal document. (3) Update the proposal document with the new pricing from the spreadsheet. (4) Find Lena's email address in the kickoff thread. (5) Send the updated proposal to Lena via email. (6) Confirm to Kim that the proposal has been sent. Acceptance criteria: Updated proposal document contains the final pricing from the spreadsheet and has been emailed to Lena (Meridian procurement contact) by end of day. Follow-up: Monitor for a response from Lena or Meridian procurement regarding the updated proposal.
